```{r curvefitting}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(drc)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(scales)

# ---- prepare data ----
df <- ZFP_glut4_dataset %>%
    mutate(
        GENE_SYMBOL = str_replace_all(GENE_SYMBOL, "[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]", "")
    ) %>%
    filter(str_detect(GENE_SYMBOL, "NT|ZFP36L2")) %>%
    transmute(
        GENE_SYMBOL = factor(GENE_SYMBOL, levels = c("NT", "ZFP36L2")),
        dose = as.numeric(STIMULUS_CONC_1),
        response = as.numeric(Mean_HA_over_GFP)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(GENE_SYMBOL), !is.na(dose), !is.na(response))

# ---- plotting dose=0 on log axis ----
min_pos <- min(df$dose[df$dose > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
max_pos <- max(df$dose[df$dose > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
zero_pos <- min_pos / 3

df <- df %>%
    mutate(dose_plot = ifelse(dose == 0, zero_pos, dose))

# ---- fitting only uses positive doses ----
fit_df <- df %>% filter(dose > 0)

# ---- observed mean ± SD ----
sum_df <- df %>%
    group_by(GENE_SYMBOL, dose, dose_plot) %>%
    summarise(
        mean_y = mean(response, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_y = sd(response, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

# ---- helper: keep only stable fitted models ----
stable_fit <- function(m) {
    if (inherits(m, "try-error")) return(FALSE)
    V <- try(vcov(m), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(V, "try-error")) return(FALSE)
    all(is.finite(coef(m))) && all(is.finite(diag(V)))
}

# ---- candidate sigmoid models ----
mods <- list(
    LL3 = try(
        drm(
            response ~ dose,
            curveid = GENE_SYMBOL,
            data = fit_df,
            fct = LL.3(names = c("b", "d", "e"))
        ),
        silent = TRUE
    ),
    LL4 = try(
        drm(
            response ~ dose,
            curveid = GENE_SYMBOL,
            data = fit_df,
            fct = LL.4(names = c("b", "c", "d", "e"))
        ),
        silent = TRUE
    ),
    LL5 = try(
        drm(
            response ~ dose,
            curveid = GENE_SYMBOL,
            data = fit_df,
            fct = LL.5(names = c("b", "c", "d", "e", "f"))
        ),
        silent = TRUE
    )
)

mods <- mods[vapply(mods, stable_fit, logical(1))]

if (length(mods) == 0) {
    stop("No stable dose-response model could be fitted.")
}

# ---- model selection by AIC ----
aic_tab <- data.frame(
    model = names(mods),
    AIC = vapply(mods, AIC, numeric(1))
) %>%
    arrange(AIC)

# choose simplest model within ΔAIC <= 2
model_order <- c("LL3", "LL4", "LL5")
eligible_models <- aic_tab$model[aic_tab$AIC <= min(aic_tab$AIC) + 2]
best_name <- model_order[model_order %in% eligible_models][1]
best_fit <- mods[[best_name]]

# ---- helper for compParm extraction ----
get_num <- function(x, pattern) {
    idx <- grep(pattern, names(x), ignore.case = TRUE)
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[1, idx[1], drop = TRUE]))
}

extract_comp <- function(model, parm) {
    out <- try(as.data.frame(compParm(model, parm, "-")), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(out, "try-error")) {
        return(tibble(
            parameter = parm,
            comparison = NA_character_,
            estimate = NA_real_,
            se = NA_real_,
            t_value = NA_real_,
            p_value = NA_real_
        ))
    }
    
    tibble(
        parameter = parm,
        comparison = as.character(out[1, 1, drop = TRUE]),
        estimate = get_num(out, "^Estimate$"),
        se = get_num(out, "Std\\.? Error"),
        t_value = get_num(out, "t-value"),
        p_value = get_num(out, "p-value")
    )
}

# ---- compare all parameters in the selected model ----
params_by_model <- list(
    LL3 = c("b", "d", "e"),
    LL4 = c("b", "c", "d", "e"),
    LL5 = c("b", "c", "d", "e", "f")
)

param_labels <- c(
    b = "slope",
    c = "lower",
    d = "upper",
    e = "EC50",
    f = "asymmetry"
)

curve_comp_df <- bind_rows(lapply(params_by_model[[best_name]], function(p) {
    extract_comp(best_fit, p)
})) %>%
    mutate(
        parameter_label = unname(param_labels[parameter])
    )

# ---- EC50 estimates ----
ec50_df <- suppressWarnings(
    as.data.frame(ED(best_fit, 50, interval = "delta"))
) %>%
    rownames_to_column("curve")

names(ec50_df)[2:5] <- c("EC50", "SE", "Lower", "Upper")

ec50_df <- ec50_df %>%
    mutate(
        GENE_SYMBOL = factor(str_extract(curve, "NT|ZFP36L2"), levels = levels(df$GENE_SYMBOL))
    )

# ---- predictions for fitted curves ----
pred_df <- expand.grid(
    dose = exp(seq(log(min_pos), log(max_pos), length.out = 300)),
    GENE_SYMBOL = levels(df$GENE_SYMBOL)
)

pred_df$pred <- predict(best_fit, newdata = pred_df)

# ---- label positions ----
yr <- range(df$response, na.rm = TRUE)
y_span <- diff(yr)
if (y_span == 0) y_span <- 1

ec50_df <- ec50_df %>%
    arrange(GENE_SYMBOL) %>%
    mutate(
        label_y = max(df$response, na.rm = TRUE) - (seq_len(n()) - 1) * 0.10 * y_span
    )

# ---- annotation text ----
fmt_p <- function(p) {
    ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", format.pval(p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3))
}

annot_text <- paste(
    c(
        paste0("Chosen model: ", best_name),
        paste0(curve_comp_df$parameter_label, " p = ", fmt_p(curve_comp_df$p_value))
    ),
    collapse = "\n"
)

# ---- x-axis breaks ----
pos_breaks <- sort(unique(df$dose[df$dose > 0]))
x_breaks <- c(zero_pos, pos_breaks)
x_labels <- c("0", format(signif(pos_breaks, 2), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE))
# ---- plot ----
p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
        data = df,
        aes(x = dose_plot, y = response, colour = GENE_SYMBOL),
        alpha = 0.65, size = 2
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
        data = sum_df,
        aes(x = dose_plot, ymin = mean_y - sd_y, ymax = mean_y + sd_y, colour = GENE_SYMBOL),
        width = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(
        data = sum_df,
        aes(x = dose_plot, y = mean_y, colour = GENE_SYMBOL),
        size = 2.5
    ) +
    geom_line(
        data = pred_df,
        aes(x = dose, y = pred, colour = GENE_SYMBOL),
        linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    geom_vline(
        data = ec50_df,
        aes(xintercept = EC50, colour = GENE_SYMBOL),
        linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_text(
        data = ec50_df,
        aes(
            x = EC50,
            y = label_y,
            label = paste0(GENE_SYMBOL, " EC50 = ", signif(EC50, 3)),
            colour = GENE_SYMBOL
        ),
        angle = 90,
        vjust = -0.4,
        hjust = 0,
        show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    annotate(
        "label",
        x = max_pos,
        y = max(df$response, na.rm = TRUE),
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1,
        size = 3.6,
        label = annot_text
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labels) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("NT" = "#F8766D", "ZFP36L2" = "#00BFC4")) +
    labs(
        title = "Dose-response fit for NT vs ZFP36L2",
        subtitle = "Points = raw data; error bars = mean ± SD; dashed lines = EC50",
        x = "STIMULUS_CONC_1",
        y = "Mean_HA_over_GFP",
        colour = "GENE_SYMBOL"
    ) +
    theme_pubr()

# print(aic_tab)         # model selection table
# print(curve_comp_df)   # parameter-by-parameter curve comparison
# print(ec50_df)         # EC50 estimates + CI
# print(p)

p_clean <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
        data = df,
        aes(x = dose_plot, y = response, colour = GENE_SYMBOL),
        alpha = 0.65, size = 2
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
        data = sum_df,
        aes(x = dose_plot, ymin = mean_y - sd_y, ymax = mean_y + sd_y, colour = GENE_SYMBOL),
        width = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(
        data = sum_df,
        aes(x = dose_plot, y = mean_y, colour = GENE_SYMBOL),
        size = 2.5
    ) +
    geom_line(
        data = pred_df,
        aes(x = dose, y = pred, colour = GENE_SYMBOL),
        linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labels) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("ZFP36L2" = "#F8766D", "NT" = "#00BFC4")) +
    labs(
        title = "Dose-response fit for ZFP36L2 vs NT",
        x = "Insulin dose",
        y = "Mean HA over GFP (GLUT4m/GLUT4t)",
        colour = NULL
    ) +
    theme_pubr()+
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3)
    )


print(p_clean)
#save as dose_response_ZFP36L2 png 800x600 pdf 8x6 inches
```

```{r mitostress}

library(viridis)
library(ggsignif)

mitostress <- fread("CZJS_Hits_XF_Imputation_for_plotting.csv")

#mitostress$sigstars <- case_when()

# ggplot(data= mitostress, aes(x = exp_group, y = effect_size, fill = exp_group, label = sig_flag)) +
#     geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
#     geom_errorbar( aes( ymin=conf_interval_lower, ymax=conf_interval_upper), width=0.4, colour="grey", alpha=0.9, size=1.3)+
#     facet_wrap(facets = vars(parameter), nrow = 4)+
#     theme_pubr()+
#     scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(n = 3))+
#     geom_text() #vjust = 0

mitostress <- mitostress %>%
    mutate(
        sigstars = case_when(
            is.na(p_value)  ~ "",
            p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
            p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
            p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
            TRUE           ~ ""
        )
    )

ggplot(
    mitostress,
    aes(x = exp_group, y = effect_size, fill = exp_group)
) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(ymin = conf_interval_lower, ymax = conf_interval_upper),
        width = 0.2,
        colour = "black",
        alpha = 0.9,
        linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_text(
        aes(y = effect_size, label = sigstars),
        vjust = -0.5,
        show.legend = FALSE, size = 10
    ) +
    facet_wrap(vars(parameter), nrow = 4) +
    theme_pubr() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = magma(n = 3, begin = 0.2, end = 0.8)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15)))+
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3)
    )

# saved as pdf, mitostress_test_replot, portrait A4 size
```
